title: DBA-Bench: A Production-Fidelity Benchmark for LLM-Based Database Operations Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.22165v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-based database agents show promise, but differences in task scope, testbeds, and success criteria hinder direct comparison. A shared benchmark must also preserve the operational conditions that determine whether diagnosis and remediation succeed in practice. We present DBA-Bench, guided by operational realism, outcome-first evaluation, and controlled scenario reproducibility. It evaluates agents in live PostgreSQL and distributed TiDB deployments with active workloads, stateful behavior, and multi-source observations. Success requires satisfying scenario-specific operational objectives without violating safety constraints. The primary evaluation covers 231 bounded scenarios across five operational domains, while 10 persistent scenarios extend evaluation to continued operation across interacting events. We evaluate eight automated baselines, including four frontier foundation models, two open-weight models, and two GPT-5.5-b

translated_title: DBA-Bench：面向基于大语言模型的数据库运维智能体的生产级保真基准
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据库智能体展现出广阔前景，但任务范围、测试平台和成功标准方面的差异阻碍了直接比较。一个共享的基准测试还必须保留那些决定诊断与修复在实践中能否成功的运维条件。我们提出了 DBA-Bench，它以运维真实性、结果优先的评估方式和受控的场景可复现性为指导原则。该基准在真实运行的 PostgreSQL 和分布式 TiDB 部署环境中评估智能体，这些环境具有活跃的工作负载、有状态的行为以及多源观测数据。成功要求在不违反安全约束的前提下满足场景特定的运维目标。主要评估涵盖五个运维领域的 231 个有界场景，另有 10 个持久化场景将评估扩展到跨交互事件的持续运行。我们评估了八个自动化基线，包括四个前沿基础模型、两个开源权重模型以及两个 GPT-5.5-b……
tldr: DBA-Bench 是一个具有生产级保真度的基准测试，在真实运行的 PostgreSQL 和分布式 TiDB 环境中，通过 231 个有界场景和 10 个持久化场景，以结果优先且兼顾安全约束的方式评估基于大语言模型的数据库运维智能体。
en_tdlr: DBA-Bench is a production-fidelity benchmark that evaluates LLM-based database operations agents on live PostgreSQL and TiDB deployments, using 231 bounded scenarios and 10 persistent scenarios with outcome-first evaluation under safety constraints.
